meta.name: Sprinkles ingredient seed database

conventions.pac_basis: PER-100g-AS-IS (sucrose = 100). PAC is the freezing-point-depression of 100g of the ingredient as weighed. Balance engine: contribution = mass x PAC/100. This matches Mark's original app and standard ice-cream calculators; it replaced the earlier mixed solids/product basis.
conventions.pac_formula: For pure sugars/polyols/syrups: PAC = (342.3/mean_MW x 100) x solids_fraction. For dairy: PAC = lactose_pct x 1.0 (lactose = MSNF x 0.545). Fat/cocoa/nut ingredients carry a NEGATIVE (hardening) PAC. Gums/emulsifiers/pure fats = 0.
conventions.pod: sensory, curated (no formula); stored as default with pod_min/pod_max range
conventions.target_ranges: mix PAC ~20-25 scoopable at -18C; <15 very hard; keep <=65-70% water frozen at serving temp (Mullan)
conventions.sugars_pct: FUNCTIONAL sugar solids that feed the balance engine (allulose = 100). Spec D5.
conventions.labeled_sugars_pct: What a nutrition panel declares (allulose/polyols/fibers = 0). Balance math uses sugars_pct; only the nutrition-display layer uses this. Spec rev.3 D5.
conventions.labeled_sugars_caveat: KNOWN SIMPLIFICATION: for DE-graded products (corn syrups, maltodextrins, atomized glucose) labeled_sugars_pct currently equals sugars_pct, which OVERSTATES the label figure - only the mono+di fraction (~DE%) counts as label sugars; the higher saccharides do not. Refine when per-DE saccharide splits are available.
conventions.reduced_calorie_carb: True where kcal deviates from the Atwater 4 kcal/g carb factor (allulose, all polyols, all fibers). Validation rule 3 (Atwater kcal check) must skip these or use a category energy factor. Spec rev.3 rule 3 exception.

sources.Goff: Goff & Hartel, Ice Cream, 7th ed. (2013), Tables 3.2 & 3.4 [textbook, tier 2]
sources.Mullan: Mullan (2021), Food Science & Technology (IFST), Tables 2 & 6 [peer-reviewed, tier 2]

meta.provenance_note: PAC 'calculated as-is' = 342.3/MW x solids. Dairy PAC from lactose. 'imported' = from Mark's legacy .iei (already as-is). Negative PAC = hardening. Gums/emulsifiers/pure fats = 0.
meta.negative_pac_note: Fat/cocoa/nut ingredients (cocoa, chocolate, nut pastes) carry negative PAC to model that they HARDEN ice cream. Magnitudes imported from Mark's app; treat as starting points to validate.

ingredients.name: Sucrose (table sugar)
ingredients.notes: Reference sugar. PAC and POD both 100 by definition.

ingredients.name: Dextrose (D-glucose monohydrate)
ingredients.notes: Monohydrate: 8% bound water carried by Solids%. PAC 190 on solids basis (=174.8 if water folded in - do NOT).

ingredients.name: Fructose (crystalline)
ingredients.notes: Sweetest common sugar; POD is concentration/temperature dependent.

ingredients.name: Allulose (D-psicose, rare sugar)
ingredients.notes: Rare monosaccharide (fructose epimer), MW 180 -> PAC 190 by formula, confirmed by Scoopulator. ~0.4 kcal/g (FDA-recognized), non-glycemic, does not crystallize; browns (Maillard). NOT in Goff/Mullan (postdates them) - POD 70 & kcal 40 are practitioner/manufacturer-sourced. High PAC + near-zero calories makes it a key low-cal ice-cream sweetener; often blended with a bulking sugar for solids.

ingredients.name: Invert sugar (partial)
ingredients.notes: Goff commercial invert (~partial inversion). PAC computed from effective MW 270.

ingredients.name: Trimoline / full invert syrup
ingredients.notes: Fully-inverted (what artisans mean by trimoline). Effective MW ~190-204 -> PAC ~167-190. POD conflict: Goff 95 vs practitioner ~130; default practitioner, flagged.

ingredients.name: Honey (generic)
ingredients.notes: Effective MW ~190 (fructose/glucose-dominant) -> as-is PAC ~149. Goff POD 75 (product-basis) kept; practitioner ~130 flagged. Legacy app used a higher PAC (~180) - Goff-side retained.

ingredients.name: Corn syrup 64 DE (high conversion)
ingredients.notes: Mean MW by DE.

ingredients.name: Corn syrup 42 DE (regular conversion)
ingredients.notes: Most common ice-cream glucose syrup. Mullan 28DE(MW643)->0.5 corroborates DE->MW->PAC chain.

ingredients.name: Corn syrup 20 DE
ingredients.notes: Builds body/bulk more than sweetness.

ingredients.name: High-maltose corn syrup 55 DE
ingredients.notes: High disaccharide -> lower FPD than dextrose-rich syrups; balances freezing.

ingredients.name: Atomized glucose 40 DE (dried)
ingredients.notes: CORRECTED: mean MW ~433 (DE40), not 980. As-is PAC ~75 - matches Mark's legacy app (79) and Goff's DE->MW logic; the earlier Underbelly-only 35 was the outlier.

ingredients.name: Maltodextrin 18 DE
ingredients.notes: Mullan Table 2: MW 1000 -> FPDF 0.34.

ingredients.name: Maltodextrin 10 DE
ingredients.notes: Body/bulk, minimal sweetness.

ingredients.name: Maltodextrin 5 DE
ingredients.notes: Bulking agent.

ingredients.name: Lactose
ingredients.notes: Supplied in practice via MSNF, not added directly. Low POD; crystallizes -> sandiness if excessive.

ingredients.name: Trehalose
ingredients.notes: Low-glycemic; behaves like lactose (PAC 100). POD concentration-dependent.

ingredients.name: Sorbitol
ingredients.notes: Polyol. FPDF 1.9 (Mullan). ~2.6 kcal/g (US). Cooling sensation; laxation threshold ~50 g/day.

ingredients.name: Erythritol
ingredients.notes: Polyol. Very high PAC (280) from low MW. ~0.2 kcal/g. Strong cooling; non-glycemic.

ingredients.name: Xylitol
ingredients.notes: Polyol/pentitol. FPDF 2.2 (Mullan). ~2.4 kcal/g. As sweet as sucrose; cooling.

ingredients.name: Glycerol (vegetable glycerine)
ingredients.notes: Very high PAC (370). Anti-crystallization, warming sensation. ~4.3 kcal/g. Use in small amounts.

ingredients.name: Inulin
ingredients.notes: Fructan fiber (technically a starch). Low POD, moderate PAC. Fat-mimetic/body. ~1.5 kcal/g.

ingredients.name: Polydextrose (Litesse)
ingredients.notes: Bulking fiber. FPDF 0.6 (Mullan). ~1 kcal/g.

ingredients.name: Whole milk (3.25% fat)
ingredients.notes: US-standard 3.25% fat; MSNF interpolated from Goff milk 3%/4% rows (8.45). Provides water to balance mix.

ingredients.name: Half & half (11.5% fat)
ingredients.notes: CORRECTED: was mislabeled as 18% fat / 193 kcal (that is light cream). True half & half ~11.5% fat / 131 kcal, per Mark's legacy app + USDA.

ingredients.name: Light cream (18% fat)
ingredients.notes: Goff 'cream 18%' row - the value the old half-and-half row actually held.

ingredients.name: Heavy cream (36% fat)
ingredients.notes: Interpolated between Goff cream 35% (5.69 MSNF) and 40% (5.35). USDA kcal 340.

ingredients.name: Heavy whipping cream (40% fat)
ingredients.notes: Goff 'cream 40%' row.

ingredients.name: Skim milk powder (NFDM)
ingredients.notes: MSNF ~96% -> lactose ~52.5% -> PAC ~52. Primary concentrated-MSNF source.

ingredients.name: Whole milk powder
ingredients.notes: Goff 'whole milk powder' row.

ingredients.name: Evaporated milk (unsweetened)
ingredients.notes: Goff 'evaporated milk, bulk' row.

ingredients.name: Sweetened condensed milk
ingredients.notes: Carries 42% ADDED sucrose PLUS lactose from MSNF -> PAC = lactose + 42. Sweet + high PAC.

ingredients.name: Butter (unsalted)
ingredients.notes: Concentrated milk-fat source. Negligible PAC/POD. Use unsalted (salt shifts freezing point).

ingredients.name: Egg yolk (fresh)
ingredients.notes: Emulsifier (lecithin). Dosage 0.5-1.0% (fresh) / 0.3-0.5% (dried) per Goff. PAC/POD ~0.

ingredients.name: Whole egg (fresh)
ingredients.notes: Dosage 2-3% for emulsification/flavor (Goff). Yolk is the functional part.

ingredients.name: Locust bean gum (E410)
ingredients.notes: Best heat-shock protection. Needs pasteurization temp to hydrate. Synergy w/ carrageenan (anti-wheying-off) & guar.

ingredients.name: Guar gum (E412)
ingredients.notes: Cold-water soluble (10-30C) - good for HTST. Higher viscosity than LBG; weaker heat-shock protection.

ingredients.name: Kappa-carrageenan (E407)
ingredients.notes: Secondary stabilizer: prevents wheying-off / serum separation at 0.01-0.015%. Gels above that. Synergy w/ LBG.

ingredients.name: Lambda-carrageenan (E407)
ingredients.notes: Cold-soluble; suspends casein, creamy melt; does NOT suppress ice crystals. Lambda-specific data scarce.

ingredients.name: Cellulose gum (CMC, E466)
ingredients.notes: Cold-soluble; high viscosity; common primary hydrocolloid. Often blended with carrageenan.

ingredients.name: Sodium alginate (E401)
ingredients.notes: Seaweed extract; needs sequestrant to control Ca. Used in some stabilizer blends.

ingredients.name: Xanthan gum (E415)
ingredients.notes: Very pseudoplastic; uniform viscosity over T/pH. Used sparingly in ice cream (can be gummy).

ingredients.name: Pectin (E440)
ingredients.notes: More common in sorbets/fruit ices. HM vs LM types behave differently - user should specify.

ingredients.name: Mono- & diglycerides (E471)
ingredients.notes: Standard ice-cream emulsifier. >40% alpha-monoglyceride for function. Waxy/dry above ~0.25%. It IS a lipid (~9 kcal/g) - aggregators wrongly list 0 kcal.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 80 (E433)
ingredients.notes: Strong fat-destabilizer at the fat interface; promotes dryness/stiffness. Dosed very low.

ingredients.name: Lecithin (soy/sunflower, E322)
ingredients.notes: Natural emulsifier; milder than mono/diglycerides. Also present in egg yolk.

ingredients.name: Cocoa butter
ingredients.notes: Pure fat. Adds hardness (harder than milk fat).

ingredients.name: Salt (sodium chloride)
ingredients.notes: FLAG: 342/58.44 = ~586 ignores NaCl dissociation. NaCl dissociates (van't Hoff ~2) so true effect ~2x (~1170). Mark's legacy app also used 586. Used in tiny amounts but verify the convention before shipping.

ingredients.name: Ethanol / spirits (as 100% ethanol)
ingredients.notes: Pure ethanol, already as-is (solids=0 so not solids-scaled). Very high PAC; softens boozy ice creams fast. Legacy 'Alcohol 40%' / 'Rum 40%' (PAC 297) are the ready-diluted forms, imported below.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil (neutral)
ingredients.notes: Non-dairy fat. Liquid at freezer temp - different structuring than milk fat.

ingredients.name: Alcohol 40%
ingredients.notes: Ready-diluted 40% ABV; PAC from ethanol. Scale by actual ABV.

ingredients.name: Almond Paste (pure)
ingredients.notes: Negative PAC = hardening contribution: fat/insoluble solids resist scooping rather than depress freezing (Mark's model; matches Mullan on nut pastes).

ingredients.name: Black Cherry
ingredients.pac_provenance: estimated (sugar x 1.85 fruit-avg; legacy had no PAC)

ingredients.name: Chocolate, dark
ingredients.notes: Negative PAC = hardening contribution: fat/insoluble solids resist scooping rather than depress freezing (Mark's model; matches Mullan on nut pastes).

ingredients.name: Cocoa Powder
ingredients.notes: Negative PAC = hardening contribution: fat/insoluble solids resist scooping rather than depress freezing (Mark's model; matches Mullan on nut pastes).

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.pac_provenance: estimated (sugar x 1.85 fruit-avg; legacy had no PAC)
ingredients.notes: Non-dairy (coconut); grouped with dairy for mix-building.

ingredients.name: Corn Starch
ingredients.notes: Contains stabilizer fraction 100%.

ingredients.name: Hazelnut Paste (pure)
ingredients.notes: Negative PAC = hardening contribution: fat/insoluble solids resist scooping rather than depress freezing (Mark's model; matches Mullan on nut pastes).

ingredients.name: Pistachio Paste (pure)
ingredients.notes: Negative PAC = hardening contribution: fat/insoluble solids resist scooping rather than depress freezing (Mark's model; matches Mullan on nut pastes).

ingredients.name: Rum 40%
ingredients.notes: Ready-diluted 40% ABV; PAC from ethanol. Scale by actual ABV.

ingredients.name: Stabilizer Mix 4421
ingredients.notes: Contains stabilizer fraction 55.5%.
